lessons.name: One semidiurnal cycle is six hours of flood and six of ebb: 6 + 6 = 12 — the tide gives back exactly the hours it took.
lessons.why: One semidiurnal cycle is six hours of flood and six of ebb: 6 + 6 = 12 — the tide gives back exactly the hours it took.

lessons.name: Two high tides fall a lunar day apart: 12h25m = 745 minutes each, and 745·2 = 1490 = 24h50m — the semidiurnal rhythm, set by the Moon.
lessons.why: Two high tides fall a lunar day apart: 12h25m = 745 minutes each, and 745·2 = 1490 = 24h50m — the semidiurnal rhythm, set by the Moon.

lessons.name: A spring tide (new or full Moon, Sun and Moon aligned, their pulls ADD) exceeds a neap (at the quarter, pulls partly cancel): 2+1 > 2−1 — the range swells and shrinks with the phase.
lessons.why: A spring tide (new or full Moon, Sun and Moon aligned, their pulls ADD) exceeds a neap (at the quarter, pulls partly cancel): 2+1 > 2−1 — the range swells and shrinks with the phase.

lessons.name: The rule is a palindrome — [1,2,3,3,2,1] reversed is itself: flood and ebb mirror, the tide fills as it drains.
lessons.why: The rule is a palindrome — [1,2,3,3,2,1] reversed is itself: flood and ebb mirror, the tide fills as it drains.

lessons.name: By the third hour the water stands at HALF its range: 1+2+3 = 6 of 12 (2·6 = 12) — half-tide falls at mid-flood.
lessons.why: By the third hour the water stands at HALF its range: 1+2+3 = 6 of 12 (2·6 = 12) — half-tide falls at mid-flood.

lessons.name: The sailor's rule of twelfths: over six hours a tide rises 1,2,3,3,2,1 twelfths of its range — and 1+2+3+3+2+1 = 12, the whole range accounted for.
lessons.why: The sailor's rule of twelfths: over six hours a tide rises 1,2,3,3,2,1 twelfths of its range — and 1+2+3+3+2+1 = 12, the whole range accounted for.
